description: This PHP source file implements an ADODB-based session handler, providing functions and a class to manage session data storage and retrieval in a database with support for session regeneration, creation, destruction, and garbage collection.

classes.name: ADODB_Session
classes.description: A static class implementing session management using a database backend, supporting configuration, connection, read/write, destroy, and garbage collection of sessions.

methods.name: adodb_unserialize
methods.description: Unserializes a session string into an associative array.

methods.name: adodb_session_regenerate_id
methods.description: Regenerates the session ID, updating the database record accordingly.

methods.name: adodb_session_create_table
methods.description: Creates the session table in the database as specified by an XML schema file.
